title: Twelve voices from China: On publishing, community, and how the field of genomics is developing
authors: Jian Yang, Yong Zhang, Siyang Liu, Yan Zheng, Gangqiao Zhou, Shu-Jin Luo, Hongxia Ma, Chaoyang Sun, Kai Ye, Y.M. Dennis Lo, Xiaoyue Wang, Lei Wang
abstract: To mark 5 years of Cell Genomics, we asked authors across China to reflect on their research and the field of genomics. Together, these voices reflect on their findings, publishing, belonging to a community, and what shape the field’s next 5 years should take.

title: Mitotic and meiotic midbody remnants: Divergent architectures with distinct clinical applications
abstract: Midbody remnants adopt division-mode-specific functions.
